title: Report Object Sizes
prompt:
Implement `void program(void)` that prints the sizes of the fundamental integer types on this platform, one per line:
 
```
char: 1
short: 2
int: 4
long: 8
```
 
Use `sizeof` for each type — your code must compute them, not hard-code numbers.

tests.name: all four sizes
tests.hint: Four printf calls, each ending with the newline escape; format %zu with sizeof(T). char is 1 by definition.

tests.name: deterministic
tests.code:
for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) { const char* out = cj_capture(program); CHECK_STR_EQ(out, "char: 1
short: 2
int: 4
long: 8
"); }
tests.hint: sizeof is a compile-time constant — repeated runs are identical.
